sanskrit_verse: ब्राह्मणोऽपि निधिं लब्ध्वा क्षिप्रं राज्ञे निवेदयेत । तेन दत्तं च भुञ्जीत स्तेनः स्यादनिवेदयन् ॥
transliteration: brāhmaṇo'pi nidhiṃ labdhvā kṣipraṃ rājñe nivedayet | tena dattaṃ ca bhūñjīta stenaḥ syād anivedayan ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Even a Brahmin, upon discovering treasure, shall immediately report it to the King; when given by him, he may enjoy it. One who does not report it becomes a thief.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority of the State in resource allocation
Capacity-based responsibility tied to knowledge and action
Restoration logic through lawful enjoyment post-reporting
Consciousness alignment via transparency and duty fulfillment
executable_legal_axioms: IF subject discovers valuable unclaimed property THEN subject MUST report discovery to governing authority WITHIN 24 hours ELSE subject assumes legal status of unauthorized possessor
IF governing authority receives report THEN authority SHALL allocate portion for lawful use by reporter ELSE no entitlement arises
IF subject conceals discovery THEN system flags potential misalignment with dharmic possession protocols UNTIL reporting occurs AND verified
IF subject consumes value without prior reporting THEN consumption deemed non-dharmic UNTIL restitution process completed
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, the threshold of responsibility is established at the moment of discovery coupled with knowledge of reporting duty. The hierarchy places the sovereign authority above individual claim, ensuring societal alignment over personal accumulation. Restoration occurs upon voluntary compliance and reintegration into lawful dispensation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is clear: knowledge + omission = distortion of dharma-vyavasthā. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as: discovery → duty recognition → choice to report or withhold → consequence as loss of lawful title. Responsibility is proportional to capacity for correct action. Non-punitive reality rule holds that withholding creates self-imposed separation from lawful flow until correction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Subject must complete formal declaration and transfer of discovered item to designated authority
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Subject acknowledges delay and enters supervised compliance pathway
Capacity Restoration: Education on dharmic stewardship and rightful ownership principles
Integrity Reintegration: Upon full compliance, public acknowledgment of corrected state and lawful enjoyment permission
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. Theft is absence of alignment. Truthful reporting restores harmony. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
